copy.npr_heading: ASKO Style 86cm XXL 16pl Fully Integrated Dishwasher – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: When dishes pile up after a large meal, running multiple loads takes extra effort. ASKO Style 86cm XXL 16pl Fully Integrated Dishwasher fits 16 place settings, uses auto dosing and offers 16 programs, with floor projection showing cycle status and Wi-Fi connectivity for control from your phone.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Large family meals can leave cookware, plates and cutlery competing for space. ASKO Style 86cm XXL 16pl Fully Integrated Dishwasher gives you room for 16 place settings in an XXL tub, so you can load more after dinner instead of sorting dishes into several cycles. Its fully integrated finish sits behind your cabinetry for a coordinated kitchen look.

When loads vary from everyday plates to tougher food messes, 16 wash programs let you choose a setting for the job. The Sensi Clean™ Sensor detects the dirtiness level, while the Super Cleaning System™ tackles heavy messes in one step. Auto dosing adds detergent as needed, so you won't need to measure it for every wash. Turbo Combi Drying helps dishes come out ready to put away.

Touch controls and an LED display keep settings clear, while delay start lets you set washing around your household routine. Floor projection uses three colours to show cycle progress and status without opening the door. Wi-Fi connectivity lets you control and monitor this dishwasher from a smartphone or tablet. A child lock helps prevent children from starting it, and the knife holder keeps blades steady during the wash cycle.

This dishwasher uses 10.6L per wash and has a 6-star WELS water rating, plus a 5-star energy rating. Door Pop-Out automatically opens the door to remove steam, while the 41dBA noise level keeps sound contained during evening cleaning. Finished in Grey, it measures 596mm wide, 859mm high and 554mm deep, and comes with a two-year warranty. Picture it handling the dinner load while you clear the table and settle in for the evening.

copy.npr_heading: ASKO Essence 60cm Pyrolytic Oven – Black Glass
copy.npr_short_copy: When weekday meals and weekend baking need different settings, ASKO Essence 60cm Pyrolytic Oven brings grilling, air frying and automatic programmes together. Precise temperature control, ConnectLife app access and pyrolytic cleaning help you cook confidently and wipe away residue with less scrubbing.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Cooking different dishes for one meal can mean switching between settings and checking temperatures as you go. This ASKO Essence 60cm Pyrolytic Oven gives home cooks a 50L cavity with precise temperature control, grilling, air frying and automatic programmes, so you can choose a suitable cooking option from one compact built-in oven.

The 3″ TFT display puts cooking functions and settings within easy reach, while ConnectLife connectivity lets you access the oven through the associated app. Telescopic runners help you pull trays forward when checking a dish, and lighting on both sides at different heights makes it easier to see what's cooking. Active cooling helps manage the oven and door glass during use.

When dinner calls for more than one technique, this oven's multifunction cooking, grill and air fry functions give you different ways to prepare meals. The included grill rack, glass baking tray and middle baking pan cover everyday grilling, baking and roasting tasks, while the multi-functional tray supports different cooking jobs. Auto programmes help you select preset options when you don't want to set everything manually.

After cooking, pyrolytic cleaning heats the oven so food residue turns to ash that can be wiped away. The black glass finish gives this oven a clean, contemporary look, while the 594mm width and 455mm height suit compact kitchen layouts. It's a practical fit for cooks preparing a quick weeknight meal, then baking or grilling for friends at the weekend.

copy.npr_heading: AEG 10kg Front Load Washing Machine 9000 Series – White
copy.npr_short_copy: When laundry piles up after busy days, AEG 10kg Front Load Washing Machine 9000 Series handles up to 10kg in one load. AutoDose adds detergent automatically, while PreciseWash adjusts settings to the load. Steam, Hygiene and delicate programs help care for everyday fabrics.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Mixed laundry can quickly fill the hamper when several people are washing clothes throughout the week. AEG 10kg Front Load Washing Machine 9000 Series handles up to 10kg per load, giving large households room for more clothes in each cycle. Its 5-star energy and 4.5-star WELS water ratings support considered everyday washing.

AutoDose adds detergent and fabric conditioner automatically, so you won't need to measure each load. PowerCare premixes detergent before washing, while PreciseWash adjusts energy use and settings according to the load weight. Together, these features help match each cycle to what's inside the drum.

Choose from Cotton, Cottons Eco, Delicate, Wool, Rinse and other programs using the electronic rotary control and touchscreen. Steam helps reduce creases, while Hygiene provides a dedicated option for white cotton items. The stainless steel CareDrum, variable spin speed and 1600rpm maximum spin speed give you more control over different laundry loads. The LCD shows cycle progress, load capacity, spin speed and when clothes will be ready.

AEGConnected lets you interact with and monitor this washer from a mobile device when connected. A 52dBA noise level supports washing in the background, while the 86L water consumption per wash and 244kWhr yearly energy consumption are clearly specified. Covered by a 5-year warranty, this white front loader suits families sorting school clothes, workwear and towels into one busy laundry day.

copy.npr_heading: LG CordZero Stick Vacuum with All-in-One Tower – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: When dust builds up during cleaning, emptying the bin can interrupt the job. This LG CordZero Stick Vacuum with All-in-One Tower compresses dirt, empties dust into its tower and stores accessories, while dual nozzles and a Power Drive mop handle carpets, hard floors and wet cleaning.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Cleaning several rooms can mean stopping to empty dust and find the right accessory. This LG CordZero Stick Vacuum with All-in-One Tower compresses collected dirt, then uses its tower for auto dust emptying, charging and accessory storage, so you can keep moving through everyday floor cleaning.

Max 220W suction power helps lift dirt from carpets and hard floors, while dual nozzles let you switch between cleaning tasks. A Power Drive mop adds wet cleaning, giving you one floor-care setup for regular household mess. The 2.5L tower dust capacity means the tower can hold more collected dust before it needs attention.

One Touch Control keeps operation simple when you’re moving from room to room, and the ergonomic handle supports a more comfortable grip during cleaning. The Smart Inverter motor provides the vacuum’s drive, while Kompressor Technology compresses dirt to make better use of the available capacity. Washable dustbin and filters make routine maintenance easier when cleaning day is over.

This grey vacuum measures 265mm wide, 305mm deep and 1120mm high, with a 2-year warranty. Its tower also keeps accessories together rather than leaving nozzles scattered around a cupboard. It suits homes with carpets and hard floors, whether you’re clearing crumbs from the kitchen or refreshing floors before guests arrive.

copy.npr_heading: Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: Holding a heat pack in place while you work or relax can be awkward. Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad wraps around your waist with an adjustable strap, five heat settings and focused warmth, while its soft polyester fabric flexes for closer contact and can go in the washing machine.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Long hours at a desk or a quiet evening on the couch can leave you wanting warmth around your lower back without holding a pad in place. Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad wraps around your waist with an adjustable strap that fits waists up to 54 inches, so you can keep the heat where you need it while reading, working on a laptop or relaxing.

Focused heat and flexible construction help this pad maintain closer contact with your body as you move. Five heat intensities let you choose the warmth that suits the moment, while the 90-second heat-up setting gets warmth started quickly <sup>1</sup>. The digital controller is detachable, so you can remove it before washing the pad.

Intellisense Technology helps prevent overheating and maintains a consistent pad temperature during use. The auto-off function cuts power after three hours of continuous use, and the 2.2m cord gives you room to settle near a power point. Soft velvety polyester fabric adds a comfortable feel against clothing, while the grey finish blends into your lounge or bedroom.

When the evening winds down, machine-washable fabric makes care simpler after regular use. The 370mm by 370mm pad weighs 0.95kg and comes with a two-year warranty. It suits anyone who wants focused warmth around the lower back while sitting at a desk, checking emails on the couch or reading before bed.
copy.disclaimers: (1) Setting 5 is for rapid heat up only and isn't for continuous or prolonged use.

copy.npr_heading: Zip HydroTap G5 BCS Home Classic Plus Tap – Chrome
copy.npr_short_copy: When you need boiling water for tea, chilled water for a drink or sparkling water for guests, separate appliances can crowd the kitchen. Zip HydroTap G5 BCS Home Classic Plus Tap delivers boiling, chilled, sparkling and filtered water from one chrome tap, with a safety lock and touch controls.
copy.npr_long_copy:
A crowded kitchen bench can make preparing drinks feel like a juggling act. Zip HydroTap G5 BCS Home Classic Plus Tap brings boiling, chilled, sparkling and filtered water to one chrome tap, so you can make tea, fill bottles or serve drinks without switching between appliances.

This tap uses simple touch controls and continuous flow for filling bottles, making it easier to choose the water type you need at the sink. Advanced 0.2 micron filtration supports great-tasting filtered water, while the leak-guard detection system helps identify leaks. SteriTouch antimicrobial protection is built into the Classic Plus touch-pad and key water paths for enhanced hygiene.

A boiling water safety lock helps reduce accidental dispensing when children are nearby. The under-bench command centre has a full-colour interactive touch screen with pin-code protection and customisable settings. Three energy-saving modes include on/off timers and a sensor-activated setting that sleeps when it's dark. Quiet mode adjusts fan speed automatically, helping the system operate more discreetly in an open-plan kitchen.

The tap needs a 35mm cut-out and a 1/2-inch BSP water connection. Its 339mm width, 483mm depth and 333mm height should be checked against available under-bench space before installation. A five-year warranty includes 36 months for the appliance and an additional 24 months for the tank. It's a smart fit for a home kitchen where morning tea, cold drinks and sparkling water all start at the sink.

copy.npr_heading: Zip HydroTap G5 BCSHA Home Celsius Arc All-in-One – Chrome
copy.npr_short_copy: One kitchen tap rarely covers washing up and filling glasses. Zip HydroTap G5 BCSHA Home Celsius Arc All-in-One combines boiling, chilled, sparkling and filtered water with hot and cold washing-up water, while its touch display helps you set safety and energy-saving options.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Kitchen jobs can mean switching between taps for washing up, filling bottles and preparing drinks. This Zip HydroTap G5 BCSHA Home Celsius Arc All-in-One brings boiling, chilled, sparkling and filtered drinking water together with hot and cold washing-up water, helping keep the bench area simpler and more useful.

When you're filling a bottle or preparing a drink, MicroPurity Filtration and 0.2 micron water filtration help provide filtered water from the same tap. The CO2 level indicator helps you see when the sparkling water supply needs attention, while two disposable CO2 cylinders are included. G5 technology and an air-cooled system support the unit's different water modes.

The under-bench command centre has a full-colour interactive touch screen, so you can adjust settings without reaching under the bench. Pin code protection helps control access to settings, while boiling water safety mode adds a safeguard for busy kitchens. Three energy-saving modes, including on/off timers and a 2-hour sleep mode, let you set operation around your household routine. Quiet mode adjusts fan speed automatically, and Steri Touch protection is included in key water paths.

This tap has a 5-star WELS rating with water usage of 6L per minute, plus a 1.8kW 220-240V 50Hz power rating. It needs a 50mm bench cut-out and measures 339mm wide, 483mm deep and 333mm high. With its chrome finish and 5-year warranty, it's a strong fit for a kitchen where washing up and filling a glass happen side by side.

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Undermount Rangehood 900mm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Steam, smoke and cooking smells can quickly fill a busy kitchen. Schweigen Silent Undermount Rangehood 900mm uses ducted extraction, five speed levels and soft-touch controls to help clear the air, while dishwasher-safe mesh filters and LED lighting make everyday cooking and cleaning easier.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Busy cooking can leave steam and cooking smells hanging around long after the meal is served. This Schweigen Silent Undermount Rangehood 900mm gives modern kitchens discreet, ducted extraction in a black steel finish, with an undermount design that fits into cabinetry and keeps the cooking area visually clean <sup>1</sup>.

The Isodrive® SE Motor supports extraction of up to 3200m3/hr when correctly ducted and installed, helping manage high-heat cooking and multi-burner meals. Five speed levels let you match airflow to what’s on the cooktop, from lighter cooking through to heavier frying. The 15-minute auto shut-off timer keeps the rangehood running after cooking, helping clear remaining vapours while you move on to serving.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display make it easy to select a fan speed or switch on the 3W LED lighting when you’re cooking or checking food. Stainless steel black mesh filters catch grease before it enters the ducting, and they’re dishwasher safe, so regular cleaning doesn’t require hand washing. This rangehood uses ducted extraction and doesn’t include a recirculation option.

Schweigen SteelFlex™ is included for installation, while the warranty covers the motor for 10 years, the canopy for five years, filters for life and GU10 LED globes for life. Measuring 1180mm wide and 295mm deep, this rangehood suits a wide cooktop concealed beneath overhead cabinetry, ready for everything from weeknight stir-fries to weekend entertaining.
copy.disclaimers: (1) Although our information and marketing states the term ‘Silent’ for certain models, the following applies to various models that are sold with certain Isodrive® Systems and baffle filters. When a model with the larger motored Isodrive® System is operated at the higher speed/s air movement may be heard. For example, while operating on speed 4 & 5 (For 5 speed models) the rangehood may be audible due to the large amount of air movement moving through the filter.

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Strong cooking smells can linger in open-plan kitchens. Schweigen Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm uses ducted extraction, five speed levels and an auto shut-off timer to clear cooking air, while soft-touch controls, LED lighting and dishwasher-safe filters simplify daily use.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Large cooktops can fill the kitchen with cooking air, especially during multi-pan meals. Schweigen Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm gives you ducted extraction in a discreet undermount format, making it a practical fit for kitchens where overhead cabinetry needs to stay streamlined <sup>1</sup>. Its black steel finish adds a bold look while keeping the rangehood mostly out of sight.

Five speed levels let you match extraction to the meal, from gentler cooking through to heavier frying. The Isodrive® SPINL motor and included Schweigen SteelFlex™ support the ducted setup, while the 15-minute auto shut-off timer keeps the rangehood running after cooking without needing another trip back to the kitchen <sup>2</sup>. This helps clear remaining cooking air while you finish serving or cleaning up.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display make it easy to select a fan speed or switch on the LED lighting while you're cooking. The stainless steel black mesh filters help capture grease, and they're dishwasher-safe, so regular cleaning doesn't require scrubbing by hand. The ducted extraction type is intended for installation that vents air externally, rather than recirculating it.

At 120cm wide and 295mm deep, this undermount rangehood suits larger cooktops and cabinetry with limited depth. It comes in Black Steel and includes a 10-year motor warranty, five-year canopy warranty, lifetime filter warranty and lifetime GU10 LED globe warranty. Picture a busy evening meal with several burners going, then a timer keeping the airflow moving while plates reach the table.
copy.disclaimers:
(1) Although our information and marketing states the term ‘Silent’ for certain models, the following applies to various models that are sold with certain Isodrive® Systems and baffle filters. When a model with the larger motored Isodrive® System is operated at the higher speed/s air movement may be heard. For example, while operating on speed 4 & 5 (For 5 speed models) the rangehood may be audible due to the large amount of air movement moving through the filter.
(2) Please make sure that the rangehood and motor have been installed as per the corresponding instruction guides in order for optimal performance (the Isodrive® Motor Manual can be found with the Isodrive® Motor, or online at schweigen.com.au).

copy.npr_heading: Haier 60cm 500 Series Freestanding Cooker, Ceramic – Stainless Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Juggling several dishes for dinner can leave cooktop space at a premium. Haier 60cm 500 Series Freestanding Cooker, Ceramic combines four ceramic cook zones with an 88L oven and 11 functions, including Air Fry and steam-assisted cooking, so you can prepare weeknight meals and larger feasts in one appliance.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Cooking several dishes at once can mean moving pots around and waiting for oven space. Haier 60cm 500 Series Freestanding Cooker, Ceramic brings four ceramic cook zones and an 88L oven together, giving busy households one place to prepare weeknight meals, family dinners and weekend feasts.

The oven has 11 functions, including Air Fry, fan bake, grill and steam-assisted cooking. Air Fry gives you another way to prepare frozen or crumbed foods, while steam-assisted cooking helps with dishes such as bread, pastries and cakes. The four cook zones let you work with multiple pots and pans when dinner has several parts.

Simple dial controls make it straightforward to select a cooking function and temperature. The oven clock and timer help you keep track of cooking, while the rear internal light lets you check food without relying on guesswork. A cooling fan helps manage heat around the appliance, and the storage drawer gives you somewhere to keep cookware close at hand.

Included accessories are an air fry tray, baking tray, grill insert and wire shelf, so you can get started with different cooking tasks. Hydro clean uses steam to lift light residue from the oven interior, and the removable door makes cleaning easier. Finished in stainless steel, this cooker measures 595mm wide by 600mm deep, carries a two-year warranty and suits a kitchen where one appliance needs to handle everything from breakfast through to a shared Sunday roast.
